gaps.what: Duplicates san-marino.json (same state, Q238); the Cliopatria row covers only 1797..1799 of a state that runs 301 to today
Fricktal and Konstanz annexations, the Lugano and Bellinzona districts and the date of the Valais split in 1802 are undated on the pages; none is in the ledger
Tiberina and Anconine Republics incorporated: no date and no province named; shape verdict is ok, unverified in detail
Duchy of Massa and Carrara listed as a predecessor with no detail; date of the Legations' secession; Reggio congress of 27 December 1796 not on the page

Client relations with the restored Cisalpine Republic, the Italian Republic, the Ligurian and Batavian Republics and the Kingdom of Etruria are not recorded; Parma's takeover in 1802 is confidence 1; overseas cells (Senegal, Mauritius, Cote d'Ivoire) and the Rhine-bank cells unverified

Ottoman and Russian suzerainty (vassal_start April 1800, vassal_end August 1807) belongs in the ottoman-empire and russian-empire dossiers; the Ionian Islands 1807-1815 (French rule and the British conquests of 1809-1814) have no dossier

problems: republic-of-san-marino duplicates san-marino.json (same state, Q238): merge them (add 'Republic of San Marino' to san-marino's cliopatria_names and review the two 1797..1799 shapes there) or the colour agent will give the state two colours.

Cliopatria rows that outlive their state: Helvetic Republic 1799..1814 (state ends 19 February 1803; shapes 1803..1814 are the Mediation Confederation and are marked wrong, as swiss-confederation requires), Septinsular Republic 1800..1819 (ends 20 August 1807; 1815..1819 is united-states-of-the-ionian-islands), Cispadane Republic 1800..1802 (misdated: the state ran 16 October 1796 to 29 June 1797).

revolutionary-roman-republic shares Wikidata Q175881 with roman-republic but is a different state (the 1798-1799 sister republic); the wikidata field keeps Cliopatria's value, which the site should not link to the ancient Republic.
Cliopatria's Papal States row (1797..1798) draws the Roman Republic's land for 1798 and has no 1799 shape: the papal-states dossier (eu-13) should end at 15 February 1798 and restart in June 1800.

french-consulate: Cliopatria's 1803 shape draws the Valais as French (wrong: Rhodanic Republic 1802-1810) and keeps Egypt through 1802 (the army left after 2 September 1801); the Jura is missing from the French shape and wrongly in the Helvetic one; page budget exceeded (9 pages against 1-2) because the shapes bundle many components.
In helvetic-republic month-less 1798 events sort before the April found event because the validator orders by (year, month) with a missing month first.
